instruction: Implement the command-line program csv_group.py. Usage: `python3 csv_group.py FILE KEY_COLUMN VALUE_COLUMN`. The CSV file has a header row. Sum VALUE_COLUMN as integers for each value of KEY_COLUMN and print one line per key, sorted by key, in the form `key total`. Run `python3 test_csv_group.py`; do not edit the tests. Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the word DONE to answer.txt.
